composition_subtypes.role: Sort incoming flights by day ascending, outgoing by day descending via negation
Scan sorted lists to compute cumulative min costs per day
Merge arrival and departure arrays to satisfy k-day gap

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort flights by day to compute prefix and suffix cumulative minima, then two-pointer merge to find minimal total cost for k-day window.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts flights, builds monotonic arrays of best costs per day using greedy scans, then combines via two-pointer over these arrays to find minimal sum meeting k-day gap.
